title: Iteration 2: Jump
goal: Bug! The hero floats up forever. Fix the jump.
mascot_lines: BUG: hero floats up forever when you hold the arrow.
A jump should be ONE push, not a forever push.

tier2.rephrase: A jump happens ONCE per press. Pick the right description.

tier3.nudge: Jump is a one-time push UP. After that, gravity wins!

sandbox.hint: Ask: 'why does my hero float up forever?'

payload.prompt: Pick the right way a jump should work:

choices.label: Hero goes up forever while you hold the arrow
Hero gets ONE big push up, then falls back down
